name: Snake, Sea (3pp)
body:
Sea Snake
CR 1

XP 400
N Medium animal (aquatic)
Init +2; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +4

DEFENSE

AC 16; touch 13, flat-footed 13 (+3 Dex, +3 natural)
hp 19 (3d8+3)
Fort +4; Ref +6; Will +2

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., swim 20 ft.
Melee bite +5 (1d4-1 plus poison)

STATISTICS

Str 8, Dex 17, Con 12, Int 2, Wis 12, Cha 2
Base Atk +2; CMB +1; CMD 14
Feats Weapon Finesse
Skills Acrobatics +11, Climb +1, Perception +4, Stealth +7, Swim +5; Racial Modifiers Acrobatics +8, Climb +4, Stealth +4, Swim +8

SPECIAL ATTACKS

Poison (Ex)

Bite–injury; save Fort DC 12, frequency 1/round for 3 rounds, effect 1d6 Con, cure 2 consecutive saves.

CONVERSION

ECOLOGY

Environment Warm aquatic
Organization Solitary or group (10-40)
Treasure None

Sea snakes are snakes adapted for living in the sea. All are poisonous. They average 6 feet long. A sea snake’s bite is little more than a pinprick, and will go unnoticed 50% of the time. Unlike other snakes, sea snakes will attack humans; they are very aggressive.
